description:
Activate Great Furnace by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Great Furnace to become a creature until end of turn.
Great Furnace dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Great Furnace from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
